name: frituras-gody
description: App de catalogo y pedidos de Frituras Gody

scripts.web:prepare: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force www | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Force -Path index.html,estilo.css,app.js,manifest.webmanifest,service-worker.js -Destination www; Copy-Item -Force -Path *.jpeg,*.png -Destination www; if (Test-Path Frituras-Gody.apk) { Copy-Item -Force Frituras-Gody.apk www }"
scripts.android:sync: npm run web:prepare && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: npm run web:prepare && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
